item.name: Find Common Healing Potion by SKU

request.description:
## Purpose

Find Common Healing Potion by its SKU using the catalog search endpoint.

## Request

GET {{baseUrl}}/api/products?q=SSC-POT-0001

The `q` parameter searches the catalog. Because `status` is omitted,  
the API defaults to canonical products.

## Expected response

- HTTP 200.
    
- Schema version 1.
    
- Exactly one product: Common Healing Potion, SKU SSC-POT-0001.
    
- Price: 5 Copper per ounce.
    
- `total` equals 1 and matches the number of returned products.
    

## Environment

Select Spellbound Local to run against the local API.

Verify that a valid search with no matching products returns HTTP 200,  
an empty products array, and total 0—not a validation error.

Verify that an unsupported status value returns HTTP 400 and identifies  
status as the invalid parameter using a stable error code.

item.name: Exclude a matching product from a different department

request.description:
Verify that search and department filters combine using AND.  
Common Healing Potion matches the SKU query but not the selected  
ingredients department, so the response must contain no products.
